This is achieved via a causal rollout factorization that allows joint denoising of all agents' chunks before freezing them into history. The system uses a shared memory archive and pose-conditioned retrieval to align views across time and space. Visibility-gated peer sharing ensures that attention is modulated by how well peers see the current region, preventing noise from inconsistent views. The geometric scoring function enables retrieval without explicit depth estimation, relying instead on frustum overlap and viewing direction. These mechanisms together enable consistent multi-agent world modeling under causal streaming constraints.
